meta.type: single-page marketing site with live booking, contact and newsletter backed by n8n
meta.reference: Layout rhythm inspired by dhunwellness.com (video hero, 'The Menu' services reveal). No content, imagery or code is copied from the reference.
meta.disclosure: Velure is a fictional brand built as a public demo. The footer and all automated emails must say so.

stack.framework: Next.js (latest stable, App Router, src/ directory)
stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables as design tokens
stack.ui: shadcn/ui — Sheet (booking panel), Select, Calendar/Popover, Checkbox, Input, Textarea, Label, Sonner (toasts)
stack.motion: gsap + ScrollTrigger + SplitText via @gsap/react (useGSAP); lenis for smooth scroll
stack.fonts: next/font/google — Fraunces (display, variable opsz + SOFT axis) and Inter (body)
stack.hosting: Vercel (Hobby), new GitHub repo separate from thaus
stack.notes: Do not add Framer Motion. All scroll choreography lives in GSAP so there is one timing system.

assets.rules: Use next/image for all stills (sizes attribute set per layout). Videos: autoplay muted loop playsInline, preload='metadata', poster required. Load ONLY the matching video: choose src on mount via matchMedia('(max-aspect-ratio: 4/5)') — never render both <video> sources.

navigation.position: fixed top, full width, height 84px desktop / 68px mobile

states.scrolled: after 85vh: background ivory at 82% opacity with backdrop-blur(14px), espresso text, 1px stone hairline bottom. Transition 0.4s.
states.over_dark_sections: when a section with data-theme='dark' is under the nav, switch text to ivory and background to espresso_deep/80
states.hide_on_scroll: translateY(-100%) when scrolling down past 120vh, back to 0 on scroll up. 0.45s power3.out.

navigation.anchor_scrolling: All links use lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -84, duration: 1.6, easing: easeInOutExpo })
navigation.mobile: Hamburger (two thin lines morphing to X). Opens full-screen espresso_deep overlay; links 2.75rem Fraunces stagger in from yPercent 100 (0.07s stagger); 'Book now' as full-width pill at bottom; address + hours small at bottom. Body scroll locked (lenis.stop()).

sections.behavior: Shown once per browser session (sessionStorage key 'velure_intro'). Full-screen ivory panel, centered 'Velure' wordmark. Total ≤ 1.6s. Skipped entirely with prefers-reduced-motion.

principles: Slow in, soft out. Nothing bounces. Default ease 'expo.out' for entrances, 'power3.inOut' for transitions, durations 0.9–1.4s.
One idea per section. Scroll-scrubbed motion only for the hero exit, philosophy text, menu reveal and ritual line. Everything else plays once on enter.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable Lenis, all pins and scrubs; show final states; keep only opacity fades ≤ 0.3s.

Register plugins once in a client-side provider: gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText, useGSAP). Use useGSAP with scope refs and automatic cleanup. Call ScrollTrigger.refresh() after fonts load (document.fonts.ready) and after the hero video metadata loads.
motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis({ lerp: 0.085, wheelMultiplier: 0.9, smoothWheel: true, syncTouch: false }). Drive it from gsap.ticker (lenis.raf(time*1000)), gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0), lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update). Expose lenis via React context for scrollTo/stop/start.
motion.preloader: Timeline: wordmark letters (SplitText chars, mask) yPercent 110→0, stagger 0.05, 0.9s expo.out → sub line fades in 0.4s → hold 0.25s → panel clip-path inset(0 0 0% 0) → inset(0 0 100% 0), 1.0s power4.inOut, while hero video wrapper scales 1.12→1.0 (1.6s expo.out). Then hero text timeline starts.
motion.hero_intro: SplitText headline by lines with mask:'lines'; lines yPercent 105→0, stagger 0.12, 1.2s expo.out. Eyebrow and subline fade-up (y 16→0, opacity 0→1) 0.15s after. CTAs fade-up with 0.08 stagger. Nav fades in last (0.6s).
motion.hero_exit_scrub: ScrollTrigger on hero, start 'top top', end 'bottom top', scrub 0.6: video wrapper scale 1→1.08 and yPercent 0→12; overlay opacity +0.35; content y 0→-90 and opacity 1→0 (content ends at 60% of the range).
motion.philosophy_statement: SplitText words; opacity 0.14→1 with scrub, start 'top 78%', end 'bottom 45%', stagger 0.04. Pillars: hairline scaleX 0→1 (transform-origin left) then text fade-up, once, stagger 0.12.
motion.menu_reveal: Pin the stage for end '+=160%', scrub 0.8. Timeline: (0→0.65) image wrapper clip-path from 'inset(32% 36% 32% 36% round 24px)' to 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0% round 0px)'; inner image scale 1.35→1.0 (counter-zoom); (0.35→0.7) dark overlay opacity 0→0.45; (0.55→0.85) headline lines rise (yPercent 100→0) and intro fades in; (0.85→1) hold. Before the reveal, a small eyebrow 'The Menu' sits centered above the window on ivory. On mobile use end '+=110%' and start window 'inset(26% 18% 26% 18% round 18px)'.
motion.menu_list: Each row on enter (start 'top 88%', once): hairline scaleX 0→1 (0.9s expo.out) then row content y 28→0, opacity 0→1, stagger 0.08 across rows as they enter. Hover (desktop, pointer:fine only): name x 0→14px, number color taupe→gold, arrow rotates -45°→0. Preview image: one absolutely-positioned element following the pointer with gsap.quickTo (x/y, duration 0.6, ease power3); on row enter swap src (preloaded) and animate clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0)→inset(0 0 0 0) + scale 1.08→1 in 0.6s; on list leave clip back up. Mobile accordion: height auto via gsap (0.5s power3.inOut), image fades in.
motion.ritual_line: Horizontal hairline across the three steps, scaleX 0→1 scrubbed from 'top 70%' to 'bottom 60%'. Each step's numeral and text fade-up when the line passes its column (use timeline labels at 0, 0.4, 0.8). Mobile: vertical line, scaleY.
motion.section_theme_transitions: Sections declare data-theme='light'|'sand'|'dark'. A single ScrollTrigger per section (start 'top 55%', end 'bottom 55%') tweens CSS variables --bg and --fg on <body> over 0.8s power2.inOut (onEnter/onEnterBack). This produces the smooth ivory → espresso → ivory color transitions as you move through the page. Nav reads the same theme.
motion.booking_section: Image parallax yPercent -8→8 scrub. Headline lines mask-reveal once. Form fields fade-up stagger 0.05 once.
motion.contact_section: Headline mask-reveal once; form fields fade-up; newsletter card rises y 40→0 with slight delay.
motion.footer: Large wordmark: SplitText chars yPercent 100→0, stagger 0.04, 1.2s expo.out when footer top hits 80% viewport. Columns fade-up.
motion.booking_panel: shadcn Sheet, side right, width min(560px, 100vw). Overlay espresso_deep/40 + backdrop-blur(6px), fade 0.4s. Panel enters x 100%→0 with cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.7s; contents stagger fade-up 0.04 after 0.2s. Lenis stopped while open; focus trapped; ESC and overlay click close.
motion.micro: Buttons: fill-wipe (see design_tokens.buttons). Links: underline draw. Inputs: bottom-border style; on focus the gold line draws from left (scaleX). No custom cursor.

accessibility: WCAG AA contrast for all body text; gold used for decoration/large numerals only on light backgrounds.
Every interactive element keyboard reachable; visible focus ring 2px gold offset 3px.
Video is decorative: aria-hidden, no controls. Provide a pause toggle (small icon button bottom-left of hero) — required for autoplaying motion > 5s.
SplitText targets keep an aria-label with the full sentence; split children aria-hidden.
Form errors announced via aria-live='polite'; labels always visible (no placeholder-only fields).
performance: Lighthouse targets: Performance ≥ 90 mobile, LCP < 2.5s. LCP element is the hero poster image — preload it.
Video files ≤ 6 MB each (H.264, CRF 26–28, 1920px / 1080px wide, no audio track). Optional WebM VP9 source listed first.
Treatment images via next/image, quality 80, sizes per layout; preview images preloaded after idle (requestIdleCallback).
GSAP and Lenis loaded only in client components; no layout shift from SplitText (wait for fonts).
